verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents Kimi controlling a web browser on the user's behalf. Item kimi-docs-19 is only a help-topic title for a Kimi browser extension, with no claim that the extension navigates or acts on websites. The agent-mode, deep-research and web-search items are adjacent capabilities, not browser operation.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant operate a web browser on my behalf to research and complete tasks on websites
